messages:
Sam (Customer): Hey team — Fable Furnishings here. We want to onboard an intent/classification model for support emails (EN). Goal: auto-route 70% of tickets and surface intent + urgency. Timeline: pilot in 4 weeks. Any privacy or model concerns?
Ivy (CSM): thanks Sam. Quick Q: do emails include order numbers or payment snippets? Hosted or Dedicated preference?
Sam (Customer): includes order numbers and occasional partial card last4. Prefer Hosted for speed but can consider Dedicated for compliance.
Diego (Solutions): plan: 1) neutralize 10k sample emails 2) run classification eval (macro-F1, per-intent recall) 3) safety/PII checks + redact pipeline 4) canary routing config + human-in-loop for first 10k predictions.
Ruth (Safety): flag: ticket texts sometimes contain abusive language and personal contact details. Require PII redaction, toxicity detection (false negatives < 2%), and logging policy (prompts masked). If Dedicated chosen, KMS for keys.
Nora (AE): FYI this account is mid-renewal; success here influences expansion. If pilot slips >2 weeks we escalate to renewal lead.
Ivy (CSM): Sam — can you upload neutralized samples and an intent label mapping? Also confirm acceptance targets (e.g., macro-F1 >= 0.82, urgency recall >= 0.9)?
Sam (Customer): uploading now: "fable_emails_10k_neutral.csv" and "fable_intent_mapping.md". Targets: macro-F1 >= 0.83, routing precision >= 0.78.
ticket-bot: ticket CS-11890 created, assigned to diego.solutions. Perf/eval slot requested next Tue.
Diego (Solutions): sample eval command I'll run on test rig:
```bash
redwood eval classify --model redwood-7b-q4f16 --dataset fable_emails_10k_neutral.csv --metrics macro_f1,recall,precision --output reports/fable_intent_eval.json
```
Diego (Solutions): fallback: if hosted latency or tail issues, recommend Dedicated with small GPU + sync-batching. I'll include cost delta in report.
Ruth (Safety): I'll send a short eval rubric for PII redaction and toxicity checks (will include 50 adversarial examples). Also propose retention: logs masked and expunged after 30d.
Ivy (CSM): scheduling 30-min kickoff Wed 9am PT. Will prepare enablement doc for their support ops.
Sam (Customer): thanks — labeling team will finish by Fri. We'll join the kickoff.
Ivy (CSM): action items: Sam upload (S), Ruth safety rubric (R), Diego eval + cost delta (D), Ivy kickoff + enablement (I). Follow-up after evals. :white_check_mark:
